title: Dave's Fabricly
description: Fabricly is a optimization modpack with shaders, zoom, and OptiFine-style features for a smooth vanilla experience.
body:
Dave's Fabricly
Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric)
Genre: Optimization | Performance | Vanilla+ | Client-Side

Enhance your Minecraft experience without changing the game you know and love. Fabricly is a lightweight client-side optimization modpack that brings together performance improvements, shader support, zoom, and OptiFine-style resource pack features in one simple package. Enjoy smoother gameplay, better visuals, and improved compatibility while preserving the vanilla Minecraft experience.

Key Features:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Improved FPS and overall performance
Shader support out of the box (and built in shaders)
Smooth zoom
OptiFine-style resource pack features (connected textures, and more)
Fully client-side—works on vanilla and modded servers
Stays true to the vanilla Minecraft experience

</details>
